# Third-party marks in this folder

## Zabbix logo (`zabbix-logo-2025.png`, `zabbix-logo-2025.svg`)

The Zabbix logo, unaltered, from Zabbix's own logo kit (https://assets.zabbix.com/files/logo/Zabbix_logo_2025.zip).
It is shown in this project's README and documentation only as Zabbix's trademark policy
(https://www.zabbix.com/trademark) allows without a licence: non-commercial use, standalone and unaltered, never
smaller than 70 pixels, never as this project's own icon or on its packages. This project is free, sells nothing and has no company behind
it; its own licence (MPL-2.0) does not limit how others use its code, and grants no rights in this logo.
This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Zabbix LLC. Zabbix is a registered trademark of Zabbix LLC.

The project's own icon is `../icon.png`.
